name: io.github.pnp/pnp-powershell-mcp-server
title: PnP PowerShell
description: Manage SharePoint Online in natural language with the legacy SharePointPnPPowerShellOnline commands and author compatible PowerShell scripts. Requires Windows PowerShell 5.1.

environmentVariables.name: PNP_MCP_READONLY
environmentVariables.description: Read-only mode: true refuses every command that would change Microsoft 365.

environmentVariables.name: PNP_MCP_ALLOW_SETUP
environmentVariables.description: true lets pnp_setup_environment install the archived SharePointPnPPowerShellOnline module for the current user when it is missing.
